answer: Propose a pearl quote: a certified secure element signs a fresh nonce and its immutable serial. Validators give one serial one reward slot per epoch; the terrace audit calls every slot at an unpredictable shared instant, so replayed quotes fail. An oasis payout opens only for a live quote tied to its agent key. A farm can rent hardware, but each clone needs a different physical element held through the epoch, not another shared model. Proposed validators reject duplicate serials and forfeit those deposits; skipping a live quote voids the slot. This depends on trustworthy manufacturers.
